name: HDR-GS Initialization and Optimization
definition: Initialization strategy addressing NDC coordinate limitations by using SfM to recalibrate camera parameters and compute initial 3D Gaussian positions from LDR images.
summary: HDR-GS Initialization and Optimization initializes 3D Gaussian Splatting for HDR novel view synthesis by recalibrating camera parameters using LDR views and optimizing with combined pixel-wise and mu-law constraint losses.
